title: Leitstand-Lifecycle-Consumer deployen und live verifizieren
goal: Deploye nach verifiziertem T063-Merge den exakten Leitstand-main-Commit über den kanonischen Releaseadapter und belege per Runtime-, HTTP- und Browser-Readback, dass Lifecycle, technische Freshness und Runtime-Gesundheit getrennt dargestellt werden.

approval.note: Authorizes only the exact T063 merge commit to be deployed through scripts/leitstand-release.py after fresh conflict, rollback and source-identity checks. Systemkatalog remains read-only and foreign work must not be interrupted or overridden.

acceptance.assertion: The deployment input is the exact verified T063 merge commit on current main.
Deployment uses scripts/leitstand-release.py and preserves the transactional web and storage-health runtime contract.
The exact prior release and rollback path are recorded before cutover.
Units, release identity, HTTP routes and required health checks are green after cutover.
The production ecosystem map shows Heimserver as retired or außer Betrieb without presenting that lifecycle as a current runtime failure; filters and source links work.

process_deviation.description: T062 requires the exact verified T063 merge commit as its first acceptance input. T063 is terminal cancelled and explicitly not verified because its required pre-merge receipts were irreversibly lost after an external merge. A deployment retry cannot recreate that prerequisite.
process_deviation.consequence: T062 has no executable success path under its immutable acceptance contract and is terminally cancelled rather than repeatedly retried.

cancellation.reason: T062 can only execute from an exact verified T063 merge. T063 is cancelled with acceptance_disposition not_verified_and_not_retroactively_satisfied. The missing pre-merge, Captain and lease receipts cannot be manufactured after the fact, so T062 cannot satisfy its dependency or first acceptance criterion.
